feeds.title: Wide Open Spaces » Fishing Saltwater
feeds.description: Wide Open Spaces is your daily source of hunting and fishing content that's smart, funny, engaging and as outdoor-obsessed as you are. Find hunting tips and news about saltwater fishing from Wide Open Spaces.

feeds.title: Tail Fly Fishing Magazine
feeds.description: Tail Fly Fishing Magazine is the voice of saltwater fly fishing. The magazine delivers the best photography, destination travel, reputable commentary, and technical features from the saltwater fly fishing lifestyle.

feeds.title: On The Water » Saltwater
feeds.description: The Saltwater section of this blog covers saltwater fishing, surfcasting, how-to, cooking, boating, and fishing reports. Features and columns are written by local anglers who have intimate and detailed knowledge of the area. If you enjoy fishing in the Northeast's fresh and saltwater, On the Water is the magazine for you.

feeds.title: Western Outdoor News » Saltwater Fishing
feeds.description: Featuring articles that have to do exclusively with Saltwater Fishing. Western Outdoors News is a weekly outdoor newspaper and website known for its storied and thrilling freshwater and saltwater events, charters, and trips that engage over 5,000 individual anglers throughout the West each year.

feeds.title: My Catch Australia Blog
feeds.description: My Catch Australia was created originally solely as a Facebook Fishing Forum where fishermen and women from all over Australia could go to share photos of their catch, discuss and share knowledge of their fishing adventures and preferred techniques.

feeds.title: Go Saltwater Fishing
feeds.description: A fully illustrated information site about saltwater fishing from boat and shore, and on long offshore passages under sail. From bass to barracuda and whiting to wahoo, you'll find it all here.

feeds.title: Naples Saltwater Fishing Blog
feeds.description: We're dedicated to making every guided fishing trip a memory that will last a lifetime. Find information about saltwater fishing using live bait from Naples Saltwater Fishing.

feeds.title: Saltwater Experience Fishing
feeds.description: Find articles and videos on fishing knots, inshore boats, news, techniques for conventional and fly fishing, and more on saltwater fishing. Improve your fishing with podcast interviews with icons and up-and-comers. The hosts of Saltwater Experience share their passion for their sport to continue the tradition for future generations of anglers.
